images.caption: Intersection in the middle of the Y Bridge, which carries U.S. Route 40 over the confluence of the Muskingum and Licking Rivers at Zanesville, Ohio, United States.  Note the three vehicles on the bridge, each of which is going in a different direction.  The picture faces eastward: straight ahead crosses the Muskingum into Zanesville; turning around crosses the Muskingum away from Zanesville; and turning left crosses the Licking.  The bridge is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
